breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt listed two conflicting time integration methods: 'Explicit forward Euler' and 'Crank–Nicolson'. The agent correctly identified this conflict and, in alignment with the ground truth, selected 'Crank–Nicolson' as the sole method for time integration, completely omitting any mention of the incorrect 'Explicit forward Euler' method.
